question: One-third of a 3-digit number is 162 more than one-ninth of the same number. What is the sum of the digits of the 3-digit number?
solution:
Given:

One-third of a 3-digit number is 162 more than one-ninth of the same number.

Calculation:

Let 'x' be the required 3-digit number.

One-third of a 3-digit number is 162 more than one-ninth of the same number.

Mathematically it can be written as:

⇒ (x)/(3)&
